findings.summary: Android native platform coverage is incomplete.
findings.failedLink: The Pixel 8 smoke proves permission denial/recovery, keyboard activation, minimum targets, manual notification-time persistence, settings recovery and process restart, but it never drives the real photo/document pickers, notification delivery and time-zone branches, physical reminder cancellation/erasure, or advertising eligibility/no-request behavior.
findings.smallestProof: Extend and execute the Android device suite on the frozen snapshot for photo and document picker create/open/cancel, daily and soak delivery, restart/time-zone reconciliation, terminal/reset cancellation, and eligible/ineligible ad requests and layout.

findings.summary: The approved accessibility and keyboard matrix is not executed.
findings.failedLink: Goldens cover RU at 200% and source tests scan semantics APIs, while the device smoke exercises only Today, Settings and Notifications. SCREEN-001, SCREEN-003, SCREEN-005, SCREEN-006 and SCREEN-007 lack runtime reading/focus order, keyboard activation, announcements, manual date entry and 200%-font task-completion assertions.
findings.smallestProof: Run semantic traversal, visible focus, keyboard/pointer activation, state announcements, minimum targets and 200%-font task completion across every AC-122 screen and representative form/date controls.

findings.failedLink: The request explicitly marks native iOS build/platform/macOS CI execution unavailable, and the remaining Android, accessibility, lifecycle-action and backup-cancellation findings prevent the local release check from passing.
findings.smallestProof: Close the local findings, then attach successful macOS/Xcode iOS build, platform and CI evidence for the same fingerprint and rerun release closure.

findings.summary: Batch-detail lifecycle actions are exposed without state-dependent applicability.
findings.failedLink: ScreenComponentDefault falls back to every ScreenContractRegistry action and RootUiAdapter.visibleActions maps all descriptors as enabled. The accepted expanded Batch Detail golden visibly offers Confirm stage, Start soaking, Confirm sowing, Assign overflow, Undo, Skip and Schedule soak target together for a sown batch. ProductionScreenSnapshotRenderer supplies state facts but no state-filtered actions. Domain engines may reject illegal transitions, but the production component and accepted design surface still present inapplicable operations.
findings.smallestProof: Derive Batch Detail actions from the selected batch state, recipe applicability, placement, latest event and terminal status; add component assertions for every lifecycle state and regenerate/review the affected goldens.

findings.summary: QG-012 has no backup/archive cancellation proof.
findings.failedLink: Archive tests cover complete round-trip, repeat restore, malformed/unsupported/missing/corrupt photos, rollback, CSV and write failure, but no test cancels backup, validation, restore or export work and asserts that live database, files and reminders remain unchanged.
findings.smallestProof: Add deterministic cancellation tests at backup creation, archive read/validation, staged replacement and CSV write boundaries, asserting cancellation propagation and unchanged database/files/reminders.
